name: Fender Clean
description: Blackface clean: soft single tube, bright-cap high shelf, open cab 9 kHz — airy, not mid-crush.
script:
# Fender Clean
# How it sounds: Blackface clean: soft single tube, bright-cap high shelf, open cab 9 kHz — airy, not mid-crush.
# a Drive: 0.5 to 2.8, default 1.1
# b Bright: 0 to 7, default 3.2
# c Level: 0.55 to 1.45, default 1.1

param a = Drive [0.5, 2.8]
param b = Bright [0.0, 7.0]
param c = Level [0.55, 1.45]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 45; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.5)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 4800; q = 0.65; gain = b  # high shelf
stage2: y = softclip(y, 0.75) * c  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 9500; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass

name: Marshall Crunch
description: Plexi bark: dual tube, 750 Hz mid peak (not a bandpass), presence shelf, 5.5 kHz cab.
script:
# Marshall Crunch
# How it sounds: Plexi bark: dual tube, 750 Hz mid peak (not a bandpass), presence shelf, 5.5 kHz cab.
# a Drive: 1.4 to 7.5, default 3.6
# b Presence: 2000 to 7000, default 3800
# c Level: 0.38 to 1.15, default 0.72

param a = Drive [1.4, 7.5]
param b = Presence [2000, 7000]
param c = Level [0.38, 1.15]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 100; resonance = 0.38  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.6)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = tube(y, a * 0.7)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = peak; freq = 750; q = 1.05; gain = 5  # peak EQ
stage3: y = softclip(y * 1.2, 1.45) * c  # soft clip
eq2: type = highshelf; freq = b; q = 0.7; gain = 2.8  # high shelf
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 5500; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass

name: Mesa High Gain
description: Rectifier wall: tight HPF, triple tube, hard soft-knee ceiling, dark cab — densest amp.
script:
# Mesa High Gain
# How it sounds: Rectifier wall: tight HPF, triple tube, hard soft-knee ceiling, dark cab — densest amp.
# a Gain: 3.5 to 12, default 7.8
# b Tight: 45 to 200, default 85
# c Level: 0.25 to 0.9, default 0.42

param a = Gain [3.5, 12.0]
param b = Tight [45, 200]
param c = Level [0.25, 0.9]
gate1: threshold = -46; hyst = 6; hold = 0.03; range = -80  # noise gate
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.6  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.5)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = tube(y, a * 0.6)  # tube saturation
stage3: y = tube(y, a * 0.45)  # tube saturation
stage4: y = hardclip(softclip(y, 1.55), 0.68)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 4500; resonance = 0.58  # lowpass
stage5: y = diode(y, 1.6) * c  # diode clip
ir1: mix = 0.45; gain = 0  # impulse response
limit1: ceiling = -0.3; release = 0.08  # limiter

name: Vox Top Boost
description: AC chime: aggressive bass cut, 1.8 kHz peak (top-boost), glassy softclip, open cab.
script:
# Vox Top Boost
# How it sounds: AC chime: aggressive bass cut, 1.8 kHz peak (top-boost), glassy softclip, open cab.
# a Drive: 1.2 to 6.5, default 2.9
# b Cut: 280 to 1400, default 520
# c Level: 0.45 to 1.25, default 0.92

param a = Drive [1.2, 6.5]
param b = Cut [280, 1400]
param c = Level [0.45, 1.25]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.5  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.85)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = peak; freq = 1800; q = 1.15; gain = 4.5  # peak EQ
stage2: y = softclip(y * 1.15, 1.5) * c  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 8200; resonance = 0.32  # lowpass

name: Tube Screamer
description: TS808: ~720 Hz HPF into clipper, then a real 720 Hz mid peak (not a bandpass), tone LPF.
script:
# Tube Screamer
# How it sounds: TS808: ~720 Hz HPF into clipper, then a real 720 Hz mid peak (not a bandpass), tone LPF.
# a Drive: 1.2 to 11, default 5.2
# b Tone: 350 to 4500, default 1800
# c Level: 0.28 to 1.15, default 0.7

param a = Drive [1.2, 11.0]
param b = Tone [350, 4500]
param c = Level [0.28, 1.15]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 720; resonance = 0.28  # highpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, a)  # soft clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = 720; q = 1.65; gain = 6  # peak EQ
stage2: y = diode(y * 1.15, 1.3) * c  # diode clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.48  # lowpass
ir1: mix = 0.4; gain = 0  # impulse response

name: Klon Centaur
description: Transparent OD: clean path blend + soft diode clip (Klon-style clean blend).
script:
# Klon Centaur
# How it sounds: Transparent OD: clean path blend + soft diode clip (Klon-style clean blend).
# a Drive: 0.8 to 8, default 3
# b Blend: 0.2 to 0.95, default 0.62
# c Level: 0.4 to 1.3, default 0.9

param a = Drive [0.8, 8.0]
param b = Blend [0.2, 0.95]
param c = Level [0.4, 1.3]
stage1: y = x * c  # waveshape / mix
bus dirt:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 90; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
  stage2: y = diode(x, a) * c  # diode clip
  eq1: type = peak; freq = 1050; q = 0.85; gain = 3.5  # peak EQ
  filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 9000; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass
out: main = 1-b; dirt = b  # mix buses back to the output

name: ProCo RAT
description: RAT: soft-pre hard ceiling + steep LPF tone (classic filter-after-clip, low alias).
script:
# ProCo RAT
# How it sounds: RAT: soft-pre hard ceiling + steep LPF tone (classic filter-after-clip, low alias).
# a Dist: 2 to 12, default 6.5
# b Filter: 300 to 6500, default 1800
# c Level: 0.25 to 1, default 0.58

param a = Dist [2.0, 12.0]
param b = Filter [300, 6500]
param c = Level [0.25, 1.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.35  # highpass
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a * 0.55), 0.55)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.6  # lowpass
stage2: y = y * c  # waveshape / mix

name: Fuzz Face
description: Germanium fuzz: bias + soft-pre hard knee + heavy LPF + tube polish (no bare brickwall).
script:
# Fuzz Face
# How it sounds: Germanium fuzz: bias + soft-pre hard knee + heavy LPF + tube polish (no bare brickwall).
# a Fuzz: 3 to 16, default 9
# b Tone: 250 to 4500, default 1400
# c Level: 0.15 to 0.85, default 0.42

param a = Fuzz [3.0, 16.0]
param b = Tone [250, 4500]
param c = Level [0.15, 0.85]
gate1: threshold = -44; hyst = 8; hold = 0.04; range = -80  # noise gate
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 45; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x + 0.06, a * 0.4), 0.38)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.7  # lowpass
stage2: y = tube(y, 1.4) * c  # tube saturation
ir1: mix = 0.35; gain = 0  # impulse response
limit1: ceiling = -0.4; release = 0.1  # limiter

name: Soft Overdrive
description: Open softclip OD: gentle HPF, pure softclip (no mid hump), wide tone LPF — cleanest dirt.
script:
# Soft Overdrive
# How it sounds: Open softclip OD: gentle HPF, pure softclip (no mid hump), wide tone LPF — cleanest dirt.
# a Drive: 0.6 to 6, default 2.4
# b Tone: 800 to 11000, default 5500
# c Level: 0.45 to 1.35, default 0.95

param a = Drive [0.6, 6.0]
param b = Tone [800, 11000]
param c = Level [0.45, 1.35]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 50; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, a)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.32  # lowpass
stage2: y = y * c  # waveshape / mix

name: Bitcrusher
description: Soft-pre bit reduction + anti-alias LPF after quantize (never bitcrush without LPF).
script:
# Bitcrusher
# How it sounds: Soft-pre bit reduction + anti-alias LPF after quantize (never bitcrush without LPF).
# a Bits: 3 to 12, default 6
# b Drive: 0.8 to 4, default 1.8
# c LPF: 600 to 10000, default 4500
# d Level: 0.4 to 1.2, default 0.8

param a = Bits [3.0, 12.0]
param b = Drive [0.8, 4.0]
param c = LPF [600, 10000]
param d = Level [0.4, 1.2]
stage1: y = bitcrush(softclip(x, b), a) * d  # soft clip
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.45  # lowpass

name: Cyberpunk Drive
description: Guitar-shaped digital dirt: HPF, soft preamp, bitcrush, fold, short metal comb, cab LPF. Loud on purpose — not Glitch Laboratory.
script:
# Cyberpunk Drive
# How it sounds: Guitar-shaped digital dirt: HPF, soft preamp, bitcrush, fold, short metal comb, cab LPF. Loud on purpose — not Glitch Laboratory.
# a Drive: 1.8 to 9.5, default 4.6
# b Bits: 5 to 12, default 8.5
# c Fold: 0.22 to 0.68, default 0.4
# d Metal: 5 to 26, default 11
# e Tone: 1400 to 7200, default 4200
# f Level: 0.85 to 1.5, default 1.15

param a = Drive [1.8, 9.5]
param b = Bits [5.0, 12.0]
param c = Fold [0.22, 0.68]
param d = Metal [5, 26]
param e = Tone [1400, 7200]
param f = Level [0.85, 1.5]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 115; resonance = 0.4  # highpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, a * 0.5)  # soft clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = 1350; q = 0.95; gain = 3.2  # peak EQ
stage2: y = bitcrush(y, b)  # bitcrush
stage3: y = fold(y, -c, c)  # wavefold
delay1: time = d; feedback = 0.34; mix = 0.16; damp = 6800  # delay line
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = e; resonance = 0.38  # lowpass
stage4: y = diode(y, 1.32) * f * 1.35  # diode clip

name: Wave Folder
description: West-coast fold â†’ diode recovery â†’ LPF (fold is harsh; always band-limit after).
script:
# Wave Folder
# How it sounds: West-coast fold â†’ diode recovery â†’ LPF (fold is harsh; always band-limit after).
# a Drive: 1.5 to 12, default 5.5
# b Fold: 0.2 to 0.85, default 0.48
# c Level: 0.25 to 1, default 0.62

param a = Drive [1.5, 12.0]
param b = Fold [0.2, 0.85]
param c = Level [0.25, 1.0]
stage1: y = fold(x * a, -b, b)  # wavefold
stage2: y = softclip(diode(y, 1.3), 1.1) * c  # diode clip
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 7500; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass

name: Classic Tremolo
description: Opto-style sine tremolo. Rate is a note grid (1/1..1/16), one cycle per note.
script:
# Classic Tremolo
# How it sounds: Opto-style sine tremolo. Rate is a note grid (1/1..1/16), one cycle per note.
# a Rate: 0 to 1, default 0.4
# b Depth: 0.2 to 0.85, default 0.5
# c Floor: 0.2 to 0.7, default 0.4

param a = Rate [1/1, 1/16]
param b = Depth [0.2, 0.85]
param c = Floor [0.2, 0.7]
osc1: shape = sine; sync = a; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = x * (c + (1.0 - c) * (1.0 - b + b * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1)))  # waveshape / mix

name: Tremolo Free
description: Sine tremolo with free Hz rate.
script:
# Tremolo Free
# How it sounds: Sine tremolo with free Hz rate.
# a Rate: 0.2 to 10, default 3.5
# b Depth: 0.2 to 0.85, default 0.5
# c Floor: 0.2 to 0.7, default 0.4

param a = Rate [0.2, 10.0]
param b = Depth [0.2, 0.85]
param c = Floor [0.2, 0.7]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = x * (c + (1.0 - c) * (1.0 - b + b * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1)))  # waveshape / mix

name: Chopper
description: Soft-square trem chopper. Rate is a note grid (1/1..1/16). Dynamics preserved (floor).
script:
# Chopper
# How it sounds: Soft-square trem chopper. Rate is a note grid (1/1..1/16). Dynamics preserved (floor).
# a Rate: 0 to 1, default 0.45
# b Depth: 0.25 to 0.85, default 0.55
# c Floor: 0.15 to 0.55, default 0.28

param a = Rate [1/1, 1/16]
param b = Depth [0.25, 0.85]
param c = Floor [0.15, 0.55]
osc1: shape = softsquare; sync = a; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = x * (c + (1.0 - c) * (1.0 - b + b * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1)))  # waveshape / mix

name: Chopper Free
description: Same soft chopper with free Hz rate (not tempo-locked).
script:
# Chopper Free
# How it sounds: Same soft chopper with free Hz rate (not tempo-locked).
# a Rate: 0.5 to 12, default 4
# b Depth: 0.25 to 0.85, default 0.55
# c Floor: 0.15 to 0.55, default 0.28

param a = Rate [0.5, 12.0]
param b = Depth [0.25, 0.85]
param c = Floor [0.15, 0.55]
osc1: shape = softsquare; freq = a; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = x * (c + (1.0 - c) * (1.0 - b + b * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1)))  # waveshape / mix

name: Ring Modulator
description: Four-quadrant ring mod (carrier * signal).
script:
# Ring Modulator
# How it sounds: Four-quadrant ring mod (carrier * signal).
# a Freq: 15 to 1500, default 180
# b Depth: 0.35 to 1, default 0.88
# c Level: 0.4 to 1.2, default 0.85

param a = Freq [15.0, 1500.0]
param b = Depth [0.35, 1.0]
param c = Level [0.4, 1.2]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = x * (1.0 - b + b * osc1) * c  # waveshape / mix
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass

name: Uni-Vibe AM
description: Vibe-ish: dual path AM with slow LFO and soft saturation.
script:
# Uni-Vibe AM
# How it sounds: Vibe-ish: dual path AM with slow LFO and soft saturation.
# a Rate: 0.15 to 6, default 1.1
# b Depth: 0.2 to 0.85, default 0.55
# c Drive: 1 to 3, default 1.6

param a = Rate [0.15, 6.0]
param b = Depth [0.2, 0.85]
param c = Drive [1.0, 3.0]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = tube(x, c)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = y * (1.0 - b + b * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))  # waveshape / mix

name: Auto-Wah
description: Envelope follower â†’ resonant bandpass + softclip polish + AA LPF (Res on LPF kept moderate).
script:
# Auto-Wah
# How it sounds: Envelope follower â†’ resonant bandpass + softclip polish + AA LPF (Res on LPF kept moderate).
# a Sens: 0.8 to 5, default 2.2
# b Min: 180 to 700, default 280
# c Range: 800 to 4500, default 2600
# d Res: 0.8 to 2.8, default 1.4

param a = Sens [0.8, 5.0]
param b = Min [180, 700]
param c = Range [800, 4500]
param d = Res [0.8, 2.8]
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.004; release = 0.11  # envelope follower
filter1: type = bandpass; center = b; + = env1; * = c; width = 650  # bandpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, a)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 8500; resonance = d  # lowpass

name: Phaser Sweep
description: Stable phaser-ish: dual LFO-mod filters (low Q), dry/wet blend — no self-osc hang.
script:
# Phaser Sweep
# How it sounds: Stable phaser-ish: dual LFO-mod filters (low Q), dry/wet blend — no self-osc hang.
# a Rate: 0.08 to 3, default 0.45
# b Center: 300 to 1600, default 520
# c Depth: 200 to 2200, default 1400
# d Mix: 0.25 to 0.9, default 0.55

param a = Rate [0.08, 3.0]
param b = Center [300, 1600]
param c = Depth [200, 2200]
param d = Mix [0.25, 0.9]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0  # LFO
bus wet:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; + = osc1; * = c; resonance = 0.55  # highpass
  filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; + = osc1; * = c * 0.7; resonance = 0.45  # lowpass
  stage1: y = softclip(x, 1.12)  # soft clip
  filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass
out: main = 1-d; wet = d  # mix buses back to the output

name: Chorus Delay
description: Real short delay chorus + dual-rate LFO thickness — not fake AM-only chorus.
script:
# Chorus Delay
# How it sounds: Real short delay chorus + dual-rate LFO thickness — not fake AM-only chorus.
# a Rate: 0.25 to 3.5, default 1.05
# b Depth: 0.12 to 0.5, default 0.32
# c Time: 8 to 32, default 18
# d Mix: 0.18 to 0.55, default 0.34

param a = Rate [0.25, 3.5]
param b = Depth [0.12, 0.5]
param c = Time [8, 32]
param d = Mix [0.18, 0.55]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0  # LFO
osc2: shape = sine; freq = a * 1.31; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = tube(x, 1.35)  # tube saturation
delay1: time = c; feedback = 0.14; mix = d; damp = 9500  # delay line
stage2: y = softclip(y * (1.0 - b + b * 0.5 * ((0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc2))), 1.08)  # soft clip

name: Low Pass Sweep
description: Musical LFO lowpass: cutoff walks Min to Min+Depth (never Min-Depth). Rate is a note grid.
script:
# Low Pass Sweep
# How it sounds: Musical LFO lowpass: cutoff walks Min to Min+Depth (never Min-Depth). Rate is a note grid.
# a Rate: 0 to 1, default 0.45
# b Min: 180 to 800, default 420
# c Depth: 400 to 5000, default 2400
# d Res: 0.4 to 3, default 1.4

param a = Rate [1/1, 1/16]
param b = Min [180, 800]
param c = Depth [400, 5000]
param d = Res [0.4, 3.0]
osc1: shape = sine; sync = a; depth = 1.0  # LFO
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * c; resonance = d  # lowpass
stage1: y = diode(x, 1.08)  # diode clip

name: High Pass Gate
description: Envelope opens HPF for rhythmic filtering + softclip ceiling + mild AA LPF.
script:
# High Pass Gate
# How it sounds: Envelope opens HPF for rhythmic filtering + softclip ceiling + mild AA LPF.
# a Floor: 50 to 350, default 100
# b Range: 400 to 7000, default 3000
# c Attack: 0.001 to 0.04, default 0.006
# d Release: 0.04 to 0.35, default 0.14

param a = Floor [50, 350]
param b = Range [400, 7000]
param c = Attack [0.001, 0.04]
param d = Release [0.04, 0.35]
env1: type = peak; attack = c; release = d  # envelope follower
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; + = env1; * = b; resonance = 1.0  # highpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, 1.2)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 11000; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass

name: Reso Peak
description: Resonant peak filter â€” Q limited for stability.
script:
# Reso Peak
# How it sounds: Resonant peak filter â€” Q limited for stability.
# a Cutoff: 150 to 5000, default 850
# b Res: 0.6 to 3.5, default 2.2
# c Drive: 1 to 3.5, default 1.8

param a = Cutoff [150, 5000]
param b = Res [0.6, 3.5]
param c = Drive [1.0, 3.5]
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = a; resonance = b  # lowpass
stage1: y = tube(x, c)  # tube saturation

name: Bandpass Vocal
description: Formant-ish bandpass for vocal/synth body.
script:
# Bandpass Vocal
# How it sounds: Formant-ish bandpass for vocal/synth body.
# a Center: 350 to 2800, default 950
# b Width: 100 to 1000, default 380
# c Drive: 0.9 to 2.8, default 1.5

param a = Center [350, 2800]
param b = Width [100, 1000]
param c = Drive [0.9, 2.8]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = b  # bandpass
stage1: y = diode(x, c)  # diode clip

name: Heavy Comp
description: FET-ish compressor + softclip makeup ceiling + mild AA LPF (no bare hard peaks).
script:
# Heavy Comp
# How it sounds: FET-ish compressor + softclip makeup ceiling + mild AA LPF (no bare hard peaks).
# a Threshold: -36 to -8, default -16
# b Ratio: 2.5 to 12, default 5.5
# c Attack: 0.001 to 0.03, default 0.004
# d Makeup: 1 to 3.5, default 1.9

param a = Threshold [-36.0, -8.0]
param b = Ratio [2.5, 12.0]
param c = Attack [0.001, 0.03]
param d = Makeup [1.0, 3.5]
comp1: threshold = a; ratio = b; attack = c; release = 0.11  # compressor
stage1: y = softclip(x * d, 1.1)  # soft clip
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 14000; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass

name: Optical Comp
description: Slower opto-style attack/release, gentle ratio.
script:
# Optical Comp
# How it sounds: Slower opto-style attack/release, gentle ratio.
# a Threshold: -28 to -6, default -14
# b Ratio: 1.8 to 6, default 3
# c Makeup: 1 to 2.5, default 1.45

param a = Threshold [-28.0, -6.0]
param b = Ratio [1.8, 6.0]
param c = Makeup [1.0, 2.5]
comp1: threshold = a; ratio = b; attack = 0.02; release = 0.28  # compressor
stage1: y = diode(x * c, 1.05)  # diode clip

name: Parallel Crush
description: NY parallel: dry + soft-pre hard crush + LPF recovery (transparent peaks).
script:
# Parallel Crush
# How it sounds: NY parallel: dry + soft-pre hard crush + LPF recovery (transparent peaks).
# a Drive: 1.5 to 10, default 4.5
# b Blend: 0.25 to 0.9, default 0.58
# c Level: 0.45 to 1.2, default 0.85

param a = Drive [1.5, 10.0]
param b = Blend [0.25, 0.9]
param c = Level [0.45, 1.2]
stage1: y = x * c  # waveshape / mix
bus crush:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  stage2: y = hardclip(softclip(tube(x, a), 1.15), 0.65) * c  # tube saturation
  filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 10000; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass
out: main = 1-b; crush = b  # mix buses back to the output

name: Transient Bite
description: Peak envelope boosts softclip drive on attacks + mild AA LPF.
script:
# Transient Bite
# How it sounds: Peak envelope boosts softclip drive on attacks + mild AA LPF.
# a Drive: 1.2 to 6, default 2.8
# b Attack: 0.001 to 0.015, default 0.003
# c Release: 0.02 to 0.2, default 0.07
# d Amount: 0.25 to 0.95, default 0.65

param a = Drive [1.2, 6.0]
param b = Attack [0.001, 0.015]
param c = Release [0.02, 0.2]
param d = Amount [0.25, 0.95]
env1: type = peak; attack = b; release = c  # envelope follower
stage1: y = softclip(x * (a + env1 * a * d), 1.0)  # soft clip
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass

name: OTT Smash
description: Xfer-style 3-band upward + downward compressor. Depth is the smash. Time is the envelope. Insert on a bus or a group.
script:
# OTT Smash
# How it sounds: Xfer-style 3-band upward + downward compressor. Depth is the smash. Time is the envelope. Insert on a bus or a group.
# a Depth: 0.18 to 1, default 0.52
# b Time: 0.06 to 0.82, default 0.3
# c Input: 0.7 to 2.8, default 1.15
# d Low: 0.4 to 1.2, default 1
# e Mid: 0.4 to 1.2, default 0.92
# f High: 0.4 to 1.2, default 1.05

param a = Depth [0.18, 1.0]
param b = Time [0.06, 0.82]
param c = Input [0.7, 2.8]
param d = Low [0.4, 1.2]
param e = Mid [0.4, 1.2]
param f = High [0.4, 1.2]
ott1: depth = a; time = b; in = c; low = d; mid = e; high = f  # OTT (3-band up+down)
limit1: ceiling = -0.4; release = 0.05  # limiter

name: Amp Crunch
description: Edge-of-breakup: mild tube, 1.1 kHz peak, open cab — between clean and Marshall.
script:
# Amp Crunch
# How it sounds: Edge-of-breakup: mild tube, 1.1 kHz peak, open cab — between clean and Marshall.
# a Drive: 0.9 to 5.5, default 2.2
# b Tone: 900 to 7000, default 3600
# c Level: 0.4 to 1.2, default 0.88

param a = Drive [0.9, 5.5]
param b = Tone [900, 7000]
param c = Level [0.4, 1.2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.7)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = peak; freq = 1100; q = 0.9; gain = 3.5  # peak EQ
stage2: y = softclip(y, 1.05) * c  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.38  # lowpass

name: Metal Gate
description: Tight metal: HPF â†’ tube cascade â†’ soft-pre hard knee â†’ cab LPF (filter after clip).
script:
# Metal Gate
# How it sounds: Tight metal: HPF â†’ tube cascade â†’ soft-pre hard knee â†’ cab LPF (filter after clip).
# a Drive: 4 to 14, default 8.5
# b LowCut: 70 to 350, default 140
# c Level: 0.2 to 0.85, default 0.45

param a = Drive [4.0, 14.0]
param b = LowCut [70, 350]
param c = Level [0.2, 0.85]
gate1: threshold = -42; hyst = 8; hold = 0.025; range = -80  # noise gate
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.5  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.45)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = hardclip(softclip(tube(y, a * 0.5), 1.1), 0.5)  # tube saturation
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 4800; resonance = 0.6  # lowpass
stage3: y = y * c  # waveshape / mix
ir1: mix = 0.5; gain = 0  # impulse response
limit1: ceiling = -0.3; release = 0.08  # limiter

name: Blues Breakup
description: Touch-sensitive blues OD with bias.
script:
# Blues Breakup
# How it sounds: Touch-sensitive blues OD with bias.
# a Drive: 1 to 5.5, default 2.5
# b Bias: 0 to 0.22, default 0.07
# c Level: 0.5 to 1.25, default 0.95

param a = Drive [1.0, 5.5]
param b = Bias [0.0, 0.22]
param c = Level [0.5, 1.25]
stage1: y = tube(x + b * 0.5, a) * c  # tube saturation
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 5500; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass

name: Lead Boost
description: Lead boost into saturated power stage + presence shelf (not a darker LPF).
script:
# Lead Boost
# How it sounds: Lead boost into saturated power stage + presence shelf (not a darker LPF).
# a Boost: 1.5 to 7, default 3.8
# b Presence: 1800 to 7000, default 3400
# c Level: 0.4 to 1.15, default 0.8

param a = Boost [1.5, 7.0]
param b = Presence [1800, 7000]
param c = Level [0.4, 1.15]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 100; resonance = 0.35  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = b; q = 0.7; gain = 3.2  # high shelf
stage2: y = diode(y, 1.35) * c  # diode clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 6200; resonance = 0.42  # lowpass

name: Pedal OD
description: Asymmetric diode pedal: soft pre + diode stack + dark tone — different grit than softclip-only OD.
script:
# Pedal OD
# How it sounds: Asymmetric diode pedal: soft pre + diode stack + dark tone — different grit than softclip-only OD.
# a Drive: 1.2 to 9.5, default 4.2
# b Tone: 400 to 4200, default 1900
# c Level: 0.28 to 1.1, default 0.68

param a = Drive [1.2, 9.5]
param b = Tone [400, 4200]
param c = Level [0.28, 1.1]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 85; resonance = 0.32  # highpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, a * 0.55)  # soft clip
stage2: y = diode(y, a * 0.5)  # diode clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.5  # lowpass
stage3: y = softclip(y, 1.1) * c  # soft clip

name: Riff Saturate
description: Comp into tube for tight riff saturation.
script:
# Riff Saturate
# How it sounds: Comp into tube for tight riff saturation.
# a Drive: 1.4 to 6.5, default 3
# b Ratio: 2 to 7, default 3.8
# c Level: 0.5 to 1.3, default 0.92

param a = Drive [1.4, 6.5]
param b = Ratio [2.0, 7.0]
param c = Level [0.5, 1.3]
comp1: threshold = -15; ratio = b; attack = 0.007; release = 0.14  # compressor
stage1: y = tube(x, a) * c  # tube saturation

name: Bass Growl
description: Parallel clean + tube dirt, keep low end.
script:
# Bass Growl
# How it sounds: Parallel clean + tube dirt, keep low end.
# a Drive: 1.3 to 7, default 3.2
# b Blend: 0.25 to 0.85, default 0.55
# c Level: 0.45 to 1.25, default 0.9

param a = Drive [1.3, 7.0]
param b = Blend [0.25, 0.85]
param c = Level [0.45, 1.25]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 35; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
stage1: y = x * c  # waveshape / mix
bus dirt:
  send: main = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  stage2: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
  filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 7000; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass
out: main = 1-b; dirt = b  # mix buses back to the output

name: Bass Folder
description: Parallel fold for bass harmonics + diode + LPF (fold always band-limited).
script:
# Bass Folder
# How it sounds: Parallel fold for bass harmonics + diode + LPF (fold always band-limited).
# a Drive: 1.8 to 10, default 4.5
# b Fold: 0.25 to 0.8, default 0.5
# c Mix: 0.25 to 0.85, default 0.6

param a = Drive [1.8, 10.0]
param b = Fold [0.25, 0.8]
param c = Mix [0.25, 0.85]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus fold:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  stage2: y = fold(x * a, -b, b)  # wavefold
  stage3: y = softclip(diode(y, 1.2), 1.05)  # diode clip
  filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 5500; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass
out: main = 1-c; fold = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Sub Push
description: Sub-safe mild tube with gentle HPF.
script:
# Sub Push
# How it sounds: Sub-safe mild tube with gentle HPF.
# a Drive: 1 to 4, default 2
# b HPF: 25 to 100, default 40
# c Level: 0.6 to 1.35, default 1

param a = Drive [1.0, 4.0]
param b = HPF [25, 100]
param c = Level [0.6, 1.35]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a) * c  # tube saturation

name: Bass Comp Drive
description: Compress then tube â€” thick DI bass.
script:
# Bass Comp Drive
# How it sounds: Compress then tube â€” thick DI bass.
# a Threshold: -26 to -8, default -15
# b Drive: 1.3 to 5, default 2.6
# c Level: 0.5 to 1.25, default 0.95

param a = Threshold [-26.0, -8.0]
param b = Drive [1.3, 5.0]
param c = Level [0.5, 1.25]
comp1: threshold = a; ratio = 4.5; attack = 0.012; release = 0.2  # compressor
stage1: y = tube(x, b) * c  # tube saturation

name: Vocal Grit
description: Broadcast grit: HPF, tube, air LPF.
script:
# Vocal Grit
# How it sounds: Broadcast grit: HPF, tube, air LPF.
# a Drive: 1.2 to 5.5, default 2.6
# b LowCut: 80 to 280, default 130
# c Air: 2500 to 11000, default 7000
# d Level: 0.5 to 1.25, default 0.92

param a = Drive [1.2, 5.5]
param b = LowCut [80, 280]
param c = Air [2500, 11000]
param d = Level [0.5, 1.25]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.35  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a) * d  # tube saturation
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass

name: Radio Voice
description: AM radio bandpass + softclip + light bitcrush + LPF (quantize always filtered).
script:
# Radio Voice
# How it sounds: AM radio bandpass + softclip + light bitcrush + LPF (quantize always filtered).
# a Center: 500 to 2200, default 1050
# b Width: 180 to 900, default 420
# c Drive: 1.2 to 4, default 2.2

param a = Center [500, 2200]
param b = Width [180, 900]
param c = Drive [1.2, 4.0]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = b  # bandpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, c)  # soft clip
stage2: y = bitcrush(y, 10)  # bitcrush
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 6500; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass

name: Vocal Comp
description: Vocal bus compressor + soft ceiling.
script:
# Vocal Comp
# How it sounds: Vocal bus compressor + soft ceiling.
# a Threshold: -28 to -8, default -14
# b Ratio: 2.5 to 10, default 5
# c Drive: 1 to 2.5, default 1.35

param a = Threshold [-28.0, -8.0]
param b = Ratio [2.5, 10.0]
param c = Drive [1.0, 2.5]
comp1: threshold = a; ratio = b; attack = 0.005; release = 0.12  # compressor
stage1: y = diode(x, c)  # diode clip

name: Whisper Edge
description: Airy HPF into soft tube.
script:
# Whisper Edge
# How it sounds: Airy HPF into soft tube.
# a Drive: 1.1 to 3.5, default 1.9
# b HPF: 250 to 1100, default 480
# c Level: 0.55 to 1.35, default 1

param a = Drive [1.1, 3.5]
param b = HPF [250, 1100]
param c = Level [0.55, 1.35]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.55  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a) * c  # tube saturation

name: Doubler AM
description: Short slap double with mild AM on delay time + diode grit.
script:
# Doubler AM
# How it sounds: Short slap double with mild AM on delay time + diode grit.
# a Time: 12 to 42, default 22
# b Mix: 0.18 to 0.55, default 0.32
# c Drive: 1 to 2.2, default 1.3
# d Rate: 0.2 to 4, default 1.4

param a = Time [12, 42]
param b = Mix [0.18, 0.55]
param c = Drive [1.0, 2.2]
param d = Rate [0.2, 4.0]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = d; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = diode(x, c)  # diode clip
delay1: time = a + osc1 * 4; feedback = 0.08; mix = b; damp = 7000  # delay line
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass

name: Drum Smash
description: Drum bus: tube â†’ soft-pre hard ceiling â†’ glue comp â†’ diode + mild LPF.
script:
# Drum Smash
# How it sounds: Drum bus: tube â†’ soft-pre hard ceiling â†’ glue comp â†’ diode + mild LPF.
# a Drive: 1.5 to 9, default 4
# b Threshold: -26 to -6, default -13
# c Level: 0.4 to 1.15, default 0.75

param a = Drive [1.5, 9.0]
param b = Threshold [-26.0, -6.0]
param c = Level [0.4, 1.15]
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(tube(x, a), 1.15), 0.7)  # tube saturation
comp1: threshold = b; ratio = 5.5; attack = 0.002; release = 0.08  # compressor
stage2: y = diode(y, 1.15) * c  # diode clip
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 11000; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass

name: Kick Punch
description: Kick: LPF body, tube punch, fast comp.
script:
# Kick Punch
# How it sounds: Kick: LPF body, tube punch, fast comp.
# a Drive: 1.3 to 6, default 2.7
# b Tone: 90 to 700, default 260
# c Punch: 2 to 8, default 4.5

param a = Drive [1.3, 6.0]
param b = Tone [90, 700]
param c = Punch [2.0, 8.0]
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.7  # lowpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
comp1: threshold = -11; ratio = c; attack = 0.002; release = 0.055  # compressor

name: Snare Crack
description: Snare crack: HPF â†’ soft-pre hard ceiling â†’ body LPF (filter after clip).
script:
# Snare Crack
# How it sounds: Snare crack: HPF â†’ soft-pre hard ceiling â†’ body LPF (filter after clip).
# a Crack: 1.5 to 8, default 3.8
# b HPF: 140 to 550, default 240
# c Level: 0.4 to 1.15, default 0.8

param a = Crack [1.5, 8.0]
param b = HPF [140, 550]
param c = Level [0.4, 1.15]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.55  # highpass
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a), 0.75) * c  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 9500; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass

name: Room Crush
description: Drum room: tube crush into real small-room reverb + tone LPF.
script:
# Room Crush
# How it sounds: Drum room: tube crush into real small-room reverb + tone LPF.
# a Drive: 1.5 to 8, default 3.8
# b Room: 0.2 to 0.7, default 0.4
# c Mix: 0.15 to 0.55, default 0.32
# d Tone: 2000 to 12000, default 7000

param a = Drive [1.5, 8.0]
param b = Room [0.2, 0.7]
param c = Mix [0.15, 0.55]
param d = Tone [2000, 12000]
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
reverb1: size = b; decay = 0.42; damp = 0.55; mix = c; width = 0.8  # reverb
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = d; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass

name: Hat Sizzle
description: Cymbal sizzle: steep HPF + softclip (drive capped; soft only â€” no hardclip on air).
script:
# Hat Sizzle
# How it sounds: Cymbal sizzle: steep HPF + softclip (drive capped; soft only â€” no hardclip on air).
# a Drive: 1.1 to 3.5, default 1.9
# b HPF: 2500 to 9000, default 4800
# c Level: 0.55 to 1.35, default 1

param a = Drive [1.1, 3.5]
param b = HPF [2500, 9000]
param c = Level [0.55, 1.35]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.65  # highpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, a) * c  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 14000; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass

name: Acid Line
description: 303-ish: env opens LPF with musical Q, then diode.
script:
# Acid Line
# How it sounds: 303-ish: env opens LPF with musical Q, then diode.
# a Res: 0.8 to 3.4, default 2.4
# b Min: 90 to 500, default 180
# c Range: 500 to 4500, default 2400
# d Drive: 1.1 to 4, default 2

param a = Res [0.8, 3.4]
param b = Min [90, 500]
param c = Range [500, 4500]
param d = Drive [1.1, 4.0]
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.002; release = 0.16  # envelope follower
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; + = env1; * = c; resonance = a  # lowpass
stage1: y = diode(x, d)  # diode clip

name: Pad Swell
description: Slow tremolo pad with gentle tube.
script:
# Pad Swell
# How it sounds: Slow tremolo pad with gentle tube.
# a Rate: 0.05 to 1.8, default 0.22
# b Depth: 0.2 to 0.8, default 0.48
# c Drive: 1 to 2.8, default 1.5

param a = Rate [0.05, 1.8]
param b = Depth [0.2, 0.8]
param c = Drive [1.0, 2.8]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = tube(x, c)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = y * (1.0 - b + b * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))  # waveshape / mix

name: Lead Scream
description: Lead: tube â†’ restrained LPF â†’ softclip ceiling (clip after filter = less alias).
script:
# Lead Scream
# How it sounds: Lead: tube â†’ restrained LPF â†’ softclip ceiling (clip after filter = less alias).
# a Drive: 1.8 to 9, default 4.5
# b Cutoff: 500 to 7000, default 2400
# c Res: 0.6 to 2.8, default 1.6

param a = Drive [1.8, 9.0]
param b = Cutoff [500, 7000]
param c = Res [0.6, 2.8]
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = c  # lowpass
stage2: y = softclip(y, 1.25)  # soft clip

name: PWM Texture
description: Saw LFO AM texture on tube core.
script:
# PWM Texture
# How it sounds: Saw LFO AM texture on tube core.
# a Rate: 0.4 to 11, default 3.5
# b Depth: 0.25 to 0.9, default 0.6
# c Drive: 1 to 3.5, default 1.8

param a = Rate [0.4, 11.0]
param b = Depth [0.25, 0.9]
param c = Drive [1.0, 3.5]
osc1: shape = saw; freq = a; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = tube(x, c)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = y * (1.0 - b + b * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))  # waveshape / mix

name: Supersaw Dirt
description: Softclip dirt + slow AM + LPF recovery (always band-limit after softclip drive).
script:
# Supersaw Dirt
# How it sounds: Softclip dirt + slow AM + LPF recovery (always band-limit after softclip drive).
# a Drive: 1.4 to 7, default 3.2
# b Rate: 0.15 to 3.5, default 1
# c Depth: 0.1 to 0.45, default 0.22

param a = Drive [1.4, 7.0]
param b = Rate [0.15, 3.5]
param c = Depth [0.1, 0.45]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = b; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = softclip(x, a)  # soft clip
stage2: y = y * (1.0 - c + c * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))  # waveshape / mix
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 9000; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass

name: Tape Saturate
description: Tape-ish: soft magnetic saturation + HF roll-off.
script:
# Tape Saturate
# How it sounds: Tape-ish: soft magnetic saturation + HF roll-off.
# a Drive: 1 to 3.2, default 1.85
# b Blend: 0.3 to 0.9, default 0.58
# c HF: 5000 to 16000, default 11000

param a = Drive [1.0, 3.2]
param b = Blend [0.3, 0.9]
param c = HF [5000, 16000]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus tape:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  stage2: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
  filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass
out: main = 1-b; tape = b  # mix buses back to the output

name: Bus Glue
description: Mix-bus glue: gentle ratio, soft makeup.
script:
# Bus Glue
# How it sounds: Mix-bus glue: gentle ratio, soft makeup.
# a Threshold: -20 to -6, default -11
# b Ratio: 1.4 to 4, default 2.2
# c Makeup: 1 to 2, default 1.35

param a = Threshold [-20.0, -6.0]
param b = Ratio [1.4, 4.0]
param c = Makeup [1.0, 2.0]
comp1: threshold = a; ratio = b; attack = 0.018; release = 0.25  # compressor
stage1: y = diode(x * c, 1.02)  # diode clip

name: Air Exciter
description: HF excite: HPF â†’ softclip (low drive) â†’ blend â€” soft only, no hardclip on air.
script:
# Air Exciter
# How it sounds: HF excite: HPF â†’ softclip (low drive) â†’ blend â€” soft only, no hardclip on air.
# a Drive: 1.2 to 3.5, default 2
# b Freq: 2500 to 9000, default 4800
# c Blend: 0.2 to 0.65, default 0.4

param a = Drive [1.2, 3.5]
param b = Freq [2500, 9000]
param c = Blend [0.2, 0.65]
bus air:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.35  # highpass
  stage1: y = softclip(x, a)  # soft clip
  filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 16000; resonance = 0.22  # lowpass
out: main = 1-c; air = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Loudness Clip
description: Peak clipper best-practice: softclip â†’ soft-knee hard ceiling â†’ gentle AA LPF.
script:
# Loudness Clip
# How it sounds: Peak clipper best-practice: softclip â†’ soft-knee hard ceiling â†’ gentle AA LPF.
# a Ceiling: 0.55 to 0.98, default 0.9
# b Drive: 1 to 2.2, default 1.2
# c Level: 0.75 to 1.15, default 0.95

param a = Ceiling [0.55, 0.98]
param b = Drive [1.0, 2.2]
param c = Level [0.75, 1.15]
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, b), a) * c  # soft clip
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 16000; resonance = 0.22  # lowpass

name: Lo-Fi Crush
description: Soft-pre bitcrush + post LPF (quantize always filtered to tame HF trash).
script:
# Lo-Fi Crush
# How it sounds: Soft-pre bitcrush + post LPF (quantize always filtered to tame HF trash).
# a Bits: 3 to 11, default 5.5
# b Drive: 1 to 3.5, default 1.7
# c LPF: 500 to 7000, default 2800

param a = Bits [3.0, 11.0]
param b = Drive [1.0, 3.5]
param c = LPF [500, 7000]
stage1: y = bitcrush(softclip(x, b), a)  # soft clip
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.5  # lowpass

name: Cassette
description: Wobble AM + tube + muted LPF.
script:
# Cassette
# How it sounds: Wobble AM + tube + muted LPF.
# a Rate: 0.25 to 3.5, default 1
# b Depth: 0.08 to 0.4, default 0.22
# c Drive: 1.1 to 3.2, default 1.9

param a = Rate [0.25, 3.5]
param b = Depth [0.08, 0.4]
param c = Drive [1.1, 3.2]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = tube(x * (1.0 + osc1 * b), c)  # tube saturation
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 4800; resonance = 0.45  # lowpass

name: Phone Line
description: Telephone band + soft-pre bitcrush + LPF (band-limit after quantize).
script:
# Phone Line
# How it sounds: Telephone band + soft-pre bitcrush + LPF (band-limit after quantize).
# a Center: 600 to 1800, default 1000
# b Width: 200 to 800, default 450
# c Bits: 4 to 11, default 7

param a = Center [600, 1800]
param b = Width [200, 800]
param c = Bits [4.0, 11.0]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = b  # bandpass
stage1: y = bitcrush(softclip(x, 1.5), c)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 4500; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass

name: Vinyl Dirt
description: Gentle feedback dirt + roll-off (stable fb).
script:
# Vinyl Dirt
# How it sounds: Gentle feedback dirt + roll-off (stable fb).
# a Drive: 1.1 to 3.5, default 1.9
# b Dirt: 0.04 to 0.28, default 0.12
# c LPF: 1500 to 8000, default 3800

param a = Drive [1.1, 3.5]
param b = Dirt [0.04, 0.28]
param c = LPF [1500, 8000]
stage1: y = tube(x + y_prev * b, a)  # tube saturation
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.5  # lowpass

script:
# Space Echo RE-201

# b Intensity: 0.18 to 0.78, default 0.46
# c Mix: 0.18 to 0.7, default 0.4
# d Tone: 1400 to 4800, default 2600
# e Wow: 0 to 1, default 0.35
# f Spring: 0 to 0.32, default 0.12

param a = Rate [140, 620]
param b = Intensity [0.18, 0.78]
param c = Mix [0.18, 0.7]
param d = Tone [1400, 4800]
param e = Wow [0.0, 1.0]
param f = Spring [0.0, 0.32]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = 0.65; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = tube(x, 1.58)  # tube saturation
bus h1:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  delay1: time = a + osc1 * e * 8; feedback = b; mix = 1; damp = d  # delay line
  stage2: y = softclip(x, 1.08)  # soft clip

  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  delay2: time = a * 0.52 + osc1 * e * 5; feedback = b * 0.55; mix = 1; damp = d  # delay line
bus tank:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  reverb1: size = 0.26; decay = 0.32; damp = 0.52; mix = 1; width = 0.55  # reverb
out: main = 1-c; h1 = c * 0.58; h2 = c * 0.42; tank = f  # mix buses back to the output
